root.label: CTAD
root.note: Overload resolution over fictional functions built from constructors and guides picks the class's template arguments.

children.label: Implicit guides
children.note: Each constructor of the primary template becomes a function template returning C<T...>.

children.label: Primary template only
children.note: Constructors of partial or explicit specializations are never used.

children.label: No constructors
children.note: A hypothetical C() is used, so default template arguments can deduce.

children.label: T&& is not forwarding
children.note: A class parameter's T&& in a constructor does not forward during CTAD.

children.label: Type, not constructor
children.note: The winner chooses the type; real constructors then initialize it.

children.label: User-defined guides
children.note: Declarations like Bag(It, It) -> Bag<value_type>, with no body.

children.label: Same scope
children.note: A guide must be declared in the scope of its class template.

children.label: Non-template guides
children.note: Name(const char*) -> Name<std::string> needs no template head.

children.label: By-value decay
children.note: pair(T1, T2) decays arrays, so pair{1, "hi"} holds const char*.

children.label: Guides win ties
children.note: After partial ordering, a user guide beats a constructor-generated candidate.

children.label: Copy deduction
children.note: A candidate from a hypothetical C(C) is always added to the set.

children.label: Single element copies
children.note: A one-element braced list of a C specialization skips the initializer-list phase.

children.label: Two elements nest
children.note: std::vector v{other, other} is a vector of vectors.

children.label: Generic code trap
children.note: std::vector{x} copies when x is a vector and wraps otherwise.

children.label: Braces and explicit
children.note: CTAD follows ordinary initialization rules once the candidates are formed.

children.label: Iterator pairs
children.note: std::vector{b, e} holds two iterators; std::vector(b, e) holds the elements.

children.label: Explicit guides
children.note: Ignored in T x = init; selecting one in T x = {init} is ill-formed.

children.label: Later extensions
children.note: C++20 and C++23 widened where guides come from.

children.label: Aggregates (C++20)
children.note: An aggregate deduction candidate works with braces and parentheses.

children.label: Alias templates (C++20)
children.note: The aliased template's guides are adapted to the alias's parameters.

children.label: Inherited ctors (C++23)
children.note: P2582: using Base<T>::Base contributes guides; GCC 14+, not Clang 21.

children.label: Limits
children.note: Where and how much CTAD can deduce.

children.label: All or nothing
children.note: pair<int> p{1, 2.0} is an invalid template-id, not partial deduction.

children.label: Allowed places
children.note: Variables with initializers, functional casts, new, and C++20 NTTP types.

children.label: Not allowed
children.note: Non-static data members, function parameters and return types.
